scenes.label: Meet the team
scenes.title: The Connection Lab
scenes.caption: The Connection Lab’s paper rover must deliver a pretend parcel across a four-by-four grid. Tara identifies the start and finish, then Neel adds a required stamp stop. Three blocked squares and an eight-move budget make reaching the finish only one part of the challenge.
scenes.speech: The Connection Lab’s paper rover must deliver a pretend parcel across a four-by-four grid. Tara identifies the start and finish, then Neel adds a required stamp stop. Three blocked squares and an eight-move budget make reaching the finish only one part of the challenge.

scenes.label: The problem
scenes.title: What changed?
scenes.caption: The rover moves only between neighbouring squares, one row or column at a time. A diagonal jump is not allowed, and a blocked square cannot be entered. The team traces each move and checks whether the required stop was visited before approving the delivery as successful.
scenes.speech: The rover moves only between neighbouring squares, one row or column at a time. A diagonal jump is not allowed, and a blocked square cannot be entered. The team traces each move and checks whether the required stop was visited before approving the delivery as successful.

scenes.label: How it works
scenes.title: Follow the evidence
scenes.caption: After the first route works, the teacher blocks an additional square and moves the stamp to the bottom-left corner. Tara rechecks the new model instead of reusing old commands. This capstone combines modelling, conditions, sequences and testing; any route meeting every stated constraint is acceptable.

scenes.label: Your decision
scenes.title: Decide and explain
scenes.caption: The written goal requires the stamp, finish, valid neighbouring moves and at most eight moves. Compare the actions, then explain which evidence supports your decision.
scenes.speech: The written goal requires the stamp, finish, valid neighbouring moves and at most eight moves. Compare the actions, then explain which evidence supports your decision.
scenes.dialogue: A route reaches the finish but misses the stamp. Is it complete?

scenes.label: What changes
scenes.title: Check the consequence
scenes.caption: No. Revise and retest the route against every condition, including the required stop. Reaching the finish cannot compensate for missing part of the goal.
scenes.speech: No. Revise and retest the route against every condition, including the required stop. Reaching the finish cannot compensate for missing part of the goal.
scenes.dialogue: Construct a valid four-by-four route with a required stop.

scenes.label: Enter the lab
scenes.title: Investigate in the lab
scenes.caption: Investigate the whole goal, then build a valid route, then retest changed constraints. Test your plan, read feedback and try a changed case. Save evidence; explain one limitation.
